verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch platform documents only two APIs: Case Status and FOIA/PA request creation and status. The core UI capabilities are explicitly UI-only, with 'no filing API; myUSCIS is the only online filing rail.' Online form filing, fee payment, address change, G-28 representative filing and account management have no API equivalent, so the evidence contradicts API/UI parity rather than leaving its extent unproven.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
